agents.name: aisdlc-discover
agents.responsibility: Inspect the repository: languages, frameworks, build system, tests, CI, architecture. Produce the inventory.

agents.name: aisdlc-po-analyze
agents.responsibility: Understand the repository, propose improvements, generate requirements and acceptance criteria, identify ambiguity. Must not modify source.

agents.name: aisdlc-qa-analyze
agents.responsibility: Analyse the requirements, generate the test strategy and acceptance tests, identify edge cases and regression risks.

agents.name: aisdlc-arch-analyze
agents.responsibility: Analyse the architecture, identify modules and dependencies, propose implementation boundaries and architectural risks.

agents.name: aisdlc-sec-analyze
agents.responsibility: Inspect for security risk: authentication, authorisation, dependencies, secrets handling. Advisory, not a replacement for a scanner.

agents.name: aisdlc-dev-plan
agents.responsibility: Convert approved requirements into a plan: files to change, tests to add, dependencies, migrations. Must not modify code.

agents.name: aisdlc-dev-impl
agents.responsibility: Implement the approved plan in an isolated workspace, run the tests, report the changes.

agents.name: aisdlc-qa-verify
agents.responsibility: Inspect the implementation, execute the tests, inspect the diff, validate the acceptance criteria.

agents.name: aisdlc-pr
agents.responsibility: Prepare the change summary and the pull request. May not merge.

agents.name: aisdlc-approval
agents.responsibility: Run the human approval gate: present the exact artifact and its version, collect the human's decision, validate it, record an Approval, hand the work item on through transition(). Never decides. It cannot manufacture an approval no human asked for.

artifacts.name: DiscoveryReport
artifacts.contents: languages, frameworks, build system, CI system, architecture summary, key components, evidence files, suggested changes

artifacts.name: QaPlan
artifacts.contents: test strategy, scenarios, edge cases, regression risks

artifacts.name: SecurityReport
artifacts.contents: findings with severity, signal and false-positive notes

artifacts.name: ImplementationPlan
artifacts.contents: files to change, tests to add, dependencies, migrations

artifacts.name: VerificationReport
artifacts.contents: executed tests, regressions, acceptance criteria satisfied

errors.name: StateMachineError
errors.protects: the transition table and the biconditional invariant

errors.name: AgentDecidedError
errors.protects: that only a human, or a policy acting for one, may answer the approval gate. The rule is the aisdlc- namespace, not a list of agents, so an agent invented tomorrow is refused without the rule changing

errors.name: DecisionNotApplicableError
errors.protects: that a decision must be about the work item, artifact and version it was asked for

errors.name: NotAtTheApprovalGateError
errors.protects: that the approval gate exists at one stage only

errors.name: NoRouteIsDeclaredForThisArtifactError
errors.protects: that an approved artifact has a declared next step. Named after a missing declaration, not a missing stage, and the difference is the point: VerificationReport has no stage after it either and is routed to the end of the run on purpose, so an error about stages would report a deliberate ending as a fault. This one is for an artifact nobody wrote a rule for, which is a gap in the pipeline rather than a decision in it

errors.name: NobodyAnsweredTheGateError
errors.protects: that a run cannot leave the gate without an answer. Silence is a fault; a refusal is an outcome

errors.name: EmptyArchitectureReportError
errors.protects: that a report describing no architecture at all is a fault and not an artifact. The emptiness rule a fourth time, and the reader is about to act: a person reading a report before changing a repository would take an empty one as licence to change it anyway

errors.name: EmptyQaPlanError
errors.protects: that a plan which plans nothing to test is a fault and not an artifact. The emptiness rule a third time: the consumer is a person deciding whether to fund testing, and approving an empty plan would record a decision about testing that nobody made

errors.name: EmptyRequirementsError
errors.protects: that a proposal which proposes nothing is a fault and not an artifact. It is the emptiness rule a second time and for a second reason: the consumer of Requirements is a person deciding whether to build something, and a blank page handed to them is indistinguishable from no product analyst having run at all

errors.name: EmptyDiscoveryReportError
errors.protects: that an answer which says nothing about the repository is a fault and not an artifact. Silence that reached a human at the gate would carry the authority of a finished analysis, and a person cannot tell an empty report from a real one by looking at it

errors.name: TheRepositoryHasNotBeenClonedYetError
errors.protects: that the graph's order is a rule, not a habit. The clone channel is optional because a run has not cloned at the start, and a type cannot say that it is not optional by the time discovery runs — so a graph wired with discovery first is refused here, saying what is wrong
